title: SourcingPackManifest
description: Manifest for a Sourcing Pack. Declares: the source-side panels the Pack contributes (with their closed slot sets), KS list, optional Instructions Provider, requested external tools (upper bound). Engine validates the panel DAG (engine-owned target panels + Pack-owned source panels) at registration; cycles are rejected.

id.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the Pack.

instructionsProvider.description: URI of the Pack's Instructions Provider descriptor.

panels.description: Pack-owned source-side panel declarations. Engine-owned target-spine panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement/Granularity/Evidence/Confidence) MUST NOT appear here.

slots.description: Closed contribution-type set (one slot = one panel property).

dependsOnPanels.description: DAG edges. Engine-owned panel names allowed for upward bridges.

knowledgeSources.description: URIs of KS descriptors shipped by the Pack.

requestedExternalTools.description: Upper-bound list of external tools any KS in this Pack may declare in its descriptor's externalTools[]. Operator's RunConfig narrows further by binding names to host paths.
